builds.name: rabbit backshots

Build "can" be bad if there are no good ults around; otherwise its good & better than what people give it credit for.

List of good ults for melee (good ⇒ lesser good):
Wraith/Vyper (short cd), Abrams (for mid), Paige/Rem/Inf, Doorman, Yamato, Holliday, Billy (T3).

AP is pretty loose; go for the vibe of the match or the enemy team comps. You can go for T2 assistant instead of ult early if there are no good ults around, T3 rabbit can be delayed for T3 ult if the T3 ult is good (Vyper, Rem, Vic).
